splash.line3: And there are stories that, once spoken, can become a source of strength for others.

hero.sub: A story of resilience, transformation and the power to rebuild a life — and inspire others to believe in their own.

intro.title: A story of two decades of silence — and the decision to finally speak.
intro.p1: At 21, Nevena trusted the promise of a better future outside Serbia. What she found was captivity and exploitation — an experience it would take her more than twenty years to speak about out loud.
intro.p2: Today she brings her story to TV programs, stages, and conversations with other survivors, with one simple goal: turning pain into medicine, showing that it is possible to rebuild an entire life after its worst chapter.

historia.imgAlt: Behind the scenes of a shoot with Nevena Mitić

ch1.title: The offer
ch1.text: A promise of work and a better life abroad — and the decision to trust someone she knew.

ch2.title: Captivity
ch2.text: Two years without documents, without freedom, under absolute control — until the rescue.

ch3.title: The return
ch3.text: Coming back to Serbia and more than twenty years rebuilding a life in silence, far from the spotlight.

ch4.title: The voice
ch4.text: The decision to break the silence — interviews, talks, and the choice to see herself as a survivor, not a victim.

whoiam.label: Who I am
whoiam.title: I AM MORE THAN MY STORY.
whoiam.p1: My life has taken me through experiences that changed the way I see people, resilience and the human capacity to survive.
whoiam.p2: For many years, I carried a story that was difficult to speak about. Today, I choose to transform that experience into something meaningful.
whoiam.p3: I speak because I believe that sharing a story can create understanding, challenge stigma and remind someone that their past does not have to define their future.
whoiam.p4: My journey is not only about what happened to me.
whoiam.highlight: It is about who I became.

speaking.label: Speaking
speaking.title: SPEAKING WITH PURPOSE.
speaking.p1: I speak to audiences about resilience, transformation, empowerment and the courage to reclaim your voice.
speaking.p2: My talks are rooted in lived experience and designed to create connection, reflection and hope.
speaking.imgAlt: Nevena Mitić at a round-table discussion with two other women after a performance

forOrgs.label: For organizations
forOrgs.title: FOR ORGANIZATIONS MAKING A DIFFERENCE
forOrgs.p1: I collaborate with organizations, NGOs, institutions, conferences and initiatives working to create a more informed, compassionate and empowered society.
forOrgs.p2: My lived experience brings a human perspective to conversations that are often discussed through statistics, policies and institutions.
forOrgs.p3: I believe that personal stories have the power to create connection where statistics cannot.

advocacy.label: Advocacy
advocacy.title: USING MY VOICE FOR CHANGE.
advocacy.p1: I believe that raising awareness is not simply about telling difficult stories.
advocacy.p2: It is about changing the way society understands vulnerability, survival, stigma and human resilience.
advocacy.p3: My goal is to use my voice to contribute to conversations that can create awareness, understanding and meaningful change.
